# System Pros AI

> System Pros AI (systempros.ai, also written SystemPros.ai) designs, builds and commissions AI systems for small and medium businesses (1–50 staff) in New Zealand and Australia, with clients in the United States. It installs working systems, not software licences: AI receptionists and voice agents, lead generation websites, speed-to-lead outreach, private AI assistants built on OpenClaw, AI consulting and hands-on AI training.

System Pros AI is a brand of Ai and Automation Agency Ltd (Google Business Profile: "Ai and Automation Agency"). Pricing is fixed price and fixed scope, agreed after a free consultation. The single next step for a buyer is to book a free consultation at https://systempros.ai/contact/.

## Offers

- [AI Receptionist and Voice AI Agents (The Revenue Triad)](https://systempros.ai/voice-ai/): 24/7 inbound AI receptionist, speed-to-lead outbound calls, database reactivation. Integrates with existing CRMs and calendars.
- [AI Receptionist Australia](https://systempros.ai/voice-ai/australia/): the AI receptionist for Australian businesses (Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane and nationally).
- [Lead Gen Websites](https://systempros.ai/lead-gen-websites/): existing websites re-engineered into lead capture with smart forms, booking calendars, chat and voice widgets.
- [The Lead Reactor](https://systempros.ai/lead-reactor/): Meta ads to booked appointments through fast multi-channel follow-up (voice, SMS, WhatsApp, iMessage).
- [The Private Assistant](https://systempros.ai/private-assistant/): done-for-you OpenClaw private AI assistant on WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack and other messaging apps.
- [AI Consulting](https://systempros.ai/consulting/): forensic operations audit and AI roadmap (Blueprint), then implementation (Turnkey).
- [AI Consulting Australia](https://systempros.ai/consulting/australia/) and [AI Consulting New Zealand](https://systempros.ai/consulting/new-zealand/).
- [AI Training](https://systempros.ai/training/): 1-on-1 sessions on Claude Code, GoHighLevel, n8n, Make.com, voice AI and OpenClaw.
- [n8n Training and Automation Builds](https://systempros.ai/training/n8n/).
- [Pricing](https://systempros.ai/pricing/): how pricing works (fixed price, fixed scope, agreed after a free consultation).
- [Free AI Readiness Audit](https://systempros.ai/audit/): short online audit of where a business loses leads.
